build_wav2vec2_model: build a Wav2Vec2Model instance from a Wav2Vec2Config for self-supervised speech pretraining
extract_features_wav2vec2: extract features from audio waveforms using the Wav2Vec2Model extract_features method with masking control
build_transformer_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder with configurable conv positional embeddings and layer dropout for wav2vec2
apply_mask_wav2vec2: apply temporal and channel masking to wav2vec2 features using the apply_mask method during training
remove_pretraining_modules: remove pretraining modules like quantizer and final_proj from Wav2Vec2Model for fine-tuning downstream tasks
